sourceInspection.csharp: src/Sollang.Compiler/CodeGen/LlvmEmitter.Native.cs: AppendNativeArgument checks MutableBorrow before readonly references and ABI values, passes RuntimeMutableStructReference.PointerAddress directly.
sourceInspection.slg: selfhost/llvm/text/call_arguments.slg: writeCallArgument already requires callref address for native mut ABI structs. core_calls.slg: hoisted, ordinary and while reference preparation only recognize readonly type-kind 8, so no matching address is emitted. Native by-value ABI preparation correctly excludes mutable parameters and must remain separate.

decision: Use one reference-owner classification for readonly references and native mutable ABI struct parameters in all three preparation paths. Reuse the existing recursive reference-place address generation for local, forwarded, member and indexed owners. Preserve native by-value ABI coercions and readonly behavior; never copy a mutable argument to a temporary value or move the call out of its condition.
additionalSourceDecisions: While native calls must load their cached target and reuse the same native argument/result preparation as ordinary calls. Pass the while-region value writer into shared aggregate preparation, preserving readonly and mutable reference-place addresses.
Reuse S003 mutation transition for the named root of every resolved mutable argument, matching CSharp EnsureMutableBorrowName. Keep original886/975/953 controls unchanged.
